name: sec-mcp
description: Blacklist-checking agent: verifies domains, URLs and IP addresses against ten aggregated threat-intelligence feeds (OpenPhish, PhishStats, URLhaus, PhishTank, Spamhaus DROP, DShield, CINS Score, Emerging Threats, Feodo Tracker, Blocklist.de) backed by a local SQLite index. Distributed as the sec-mcp Python package; runs as a stdio MCP server (uvx --from sec-mcp sec-mcp-server) speaking JSON-RPC 2.0. No remote HTTP endpoint is hosted — the interface URL is the MCP Server Card describing how to connect.

skills.name: Indicator blacklist check
skills.description: Check one or more domains, URLs or IP addresses against the aggregated blacklist index (MCP tool: check_batch). Returns a per-indicator verdict — safe, blacklisted or invalid — with an explanation.
examples: check https://example.com/login and 203.0.113.7 against the feeds

skills.name: Blacklist index status
skills.description: Report index size, per-source entry counts, last update time and scheduler health (MCP tool: get_status).
examples: how many blacklist entries are indexed
when were the feeds last updated

skills.name: Blacklist refresh
skills.description: Force an immediate re-download and re-index of all feeds; rate limited to one forced update per interval (MCP tool: update_blacklists).

skills.name: Server diagnostics
skills.description: Diagnostic snapshot of the server: summary, full, health, performance or sample modes (MCP tool: get_diagnostics).

skills.name: Manual blacklist management
skills.description: Add or remove operator-curated blacklist entries by domain, URL or IP (MCP tools: add_entry, remove_entry).
